name: MySpace
title: Was MySpace too early? No: it lost head-to-head
question: Was MySpace too early?
answer: MySpace launched before Facebook opened to the public, passed 100 million accounts, and was bought by News Corp for $580M in 2005. It lost to Facebook head-to-head on the same broadband and the same browsers and was sold for about $35M in 2011. Same date, same enablers, different outcome: not timing.
verdict_reason: Facebook won in the same years with the same enablers.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.

graveyard.name: MySpace
graveyard.how: Sold by News Corp for about $35M in 2011, after a $580M purchase in 2005
